headline: The school fund for tools.
lead: The STEC Technology Fund is the cash path for Build Tomorrow. Gifts move through SCAD Giving. They buy, maintain, and replace the hardware and software STEC students work on.
body: This is not a lab-specific ask. It is the school fund. One gift stocks the pool that keeps classrooms, shops, and studios current.
White buttons on this site advertise out to SCAD Giving. They do not collect a card here.
